name: Tomás Korenblit
title: Bayesian Data Scientist
description: Tomás Korenblit, Bayesian Data Scientist. Notes on books, ideas, and what I'm working on.
homeBio:
I work on AI safety. Lately that's meant measuring how well LLMs follow instructions: I have a paper on it accepted at JAIIO 2026, and I just finished BlueDot's Technical AI Safety course. I also work in causal inference and read a lot of history and philosophy of science.

Feel free to send an email if you want to talk.
